entries.title: Ask HN: Just got an innocent man out of prison. What now?

entries.current_title: Ask HN: Just got an innocent man out of prison. What now?
entries.excerpt: Hi, I'm Clint Ehrlich, a hacker/law student who helped get an innocent man released from prison. I'm here on HN asking for advice about how to help my new friend get back on his feet. A year ago, I saw a Dateline NBC episode about an Iraq-war vet, Sgt. Ray Jennings, who allegedly killed an 18-year-old girl in a parking lot. The evidence didn't persuade me, so my dad and I started our own investigation. entries.guide_zh: 帮助一名无辜者获释后，法律学生兼黑客求助如何安排自己的下一步。

entries.excerpt: I recently joined a startup as their CTO and I'm hating it.
